heading: Google Pixel 10 price drops online: Details here
paragraphs: The Google Pixel 10 has received a price drop on Amazon, making it a little more affordable for buyers who have been waiting for a deal.
Originally launched in India at Rs 79,999, the Google Pixel 10 has seen a significant price cut on Amazon, bringing the starting price down to Rs 67,440.
On top of the flat discount, additional cashback perks of up to Rs 2,023 reduce the effective cost of the Pixel 10 to Rs 65,417.
Altogether, this translates to total effective savings of Rs 14,582 on the Google Pixel 10.
Delivering an experience remarkably close to the newly released Pixel 11, the Pixel 10 stands out as an exceptionally strong value proposition at this discounted price.
For starters, you get a clean Android experience with regular updates via Pixel Drops and Gemini features.
The Google Pixel 10 packs a 6.1-inch OLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate. We found the screen to be quite decent, with good colours and high brightness.
On the camera front, the Pixel 10 houses a triple rear camera setup – 48MP main, a 13MP ultrawide and a 10.8MP 5x telephoto. You also get AI features like Camera Coach.
Under the hood, the Pixel 10 uses Google’s Tensor G5 chipset. This chipset, we found, can handle day-to-day use quite well, and you can also do some gaming.
